Message.MsgText: Attribute attribute does not accept value 'value'.

Explanation.p: The specified value is not valid for this attribute. 1)If the attribute is '$operation', the following string values are valid: 'create', 'modify', 'delete' (case insensitive). If anything else is passed into the attribute an exception will occur. 2)If the attribute is 'dateFilter', it accepts a valid date in past.

OperatorResponse.p: Provide valid values for the Connector's parameters. Consult the documentation for those that are supported.

Message.MsgText: An IT registry book opened in REFRESH mode supports only CREATE operations.

Explanation.p: The IT registry Book this Connector is working with has been opened in Refresh mode, meaning only 'create' operations may be used for it.

OperatorResponse.p: Set the operation to 'create' from the '$operation' attribute or as a delta operation (for example, the operation set to delta tagged entry will override the operation attribute of the Connector). Alternatively, change the book mode to Delta (from the Init IT registry Function Component).

Message.MsgText: No class type specified in the configuration of the IT registry Ci and Relationship Connector.

Explanation.p: In order to discover the schema of this Connector, the class type parameter must be provided. Otherwise the Component does not know which attributes to display.

OperatorResponse.p: Set the required Class Type parameter from IT registry Ci and Relationship Connector's configuration panel.

Message.MsgText: IT registry Ci and Relationship Connector will work with book: book name.
The parameter param name was initialized with the value: 'value'.
The name of the currently used book 'book name' has been overridden to 'new name'.
Use an IT registry system for the needed meta-data: 'use it registry'.
The book 'book name' does not exist or is already closed.

Explanation.p: The specified parameter is needed by the IT registry Ci and Relationship Connector and must be provided.

OperatorResponse.p: Provide a value for this parameter.

Explanation.p: The specified relationship cannot be updated by the IT registry Ci and Relationship Connector and must be removed

OperatorResponse.p: Remove this relationship or change the $operation.

Explanation.p: The specified criteria is inappropriate for IT registry Ci and Relationship Connector.

OperatorResponse.p: Change the criterion to 'equals' or uncheck 'Match Any'

Explanation.p: The criteria mentioned is not in proper format for the IT registry Ci and Relationship Connector.

OperatorResponse.p: The attributes should be mention in format as specified below: (for example, cdm:Model=T61p,cdm:Manufacturer=IBM).

Message.MsgText: An exception occured while trying to close the database connection: exception message

Explanation.p: A database access error may had occured. See the exception message for details.

Message.MsgText: Configuration Item 'ci name' cannot be updated.

Explanation.p: The IT registry contains only identifying attributes for each Configuration Item. And since they cannot be updated, no update operation is supported by the Connector.

OperatorResponse.p: Change the $operation of the IT registry Ci and Relationship Connector, or remove it from the AssemblyLine.

Message.MsgText: Incorrect GUID value passed to attribute 'guid attr'.

Explanation.p: The GUID attributes of the IT registry Ci and Relationship Connector require values from type 'com.ibm.di.fc.itregistry.ConfigurationItemId'. Such objects are created by both this Connector and the Init IT registry FC.

OperatorResponse.p: Change the value of the specified attribute.

Message.MsgText: All IT registry items will be queried.
Relationship 'relationship name' cannot be fetched as 'isDeleted' is set.

Explanation.p: Relationships cannot be fetched by the IT registry Ci and Relationship Connector and must be removed for such configuration.

OperatorResponse.p: Change the artifact type or uncheck isDeleted.
